career_ladder.note: Field technical cadre under the Commissionerate of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra (कृषी आयुक्तालय, महाराष्ट्र शासन). Recruits serve an initial 3-year contractual period as Krishi Sevak on a consolidated stipend, after which they are permanently absorbed into regular state service as Krishi Sahayak (Agriculture Assistant) in Level S-8. Further promotions up to Sub-Divisional Agriculture Officer are regulated by Maharashtra Agriculture Subordinate Service Rules and State Agricultural Service Rules based on merit-cum-seniority and departmental qualifying exams.

exam_scheme.note: Conducted as an online Computer Based Test (CBT) by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) on behalf of the Commissioner of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra. The examination consists of 140 objective multiple choice questions carrying a total of 200 marks over a duration of 120 minutes. There is no negative marking. Minimum qualifying aggregate is 45% marks (90/200). Selection is determined strictly by divisional CBT merit followed by document verification without an interview.

financial_package.note: Krishi Sevaks undergo an initial 3-year mandatory contractual period on a consolidated stipend of ₹16,000 per month (substantially enhanced from ₹6,000 vide Maharashtra Government Resolution dated 07/07/2023). Upon satisfactory completion of 3 years, candidates are absorbed into regular state civil service as Krishi Sahayak in Level S-8 under Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, strictly distinct from Central 7th CPC matrices.

financial_package.estimate_note: During initial 3-year contractual service, Krishi Sevaks receive a fixed honorarium of ₹16,000 per month without DA/HRA. Upon permanent absorption as Krishi Sahayak in Level S-8, entry basic pay is ₹25,500 with 58% DA (₹14,790 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27% based on rural/urban classification: ₹2,295 to ₹6,885), Traveling Allowance for field visits, net of NPS/DCPS deduction (10% basic+DA = ₹4,029) and profession tax (₹200).
official_perks: Fixed monthly honorarium of ₹16,000 during initial 3 years; full regular state pay scale post-absorption
Retirement security under Defined Contributory Pension Scheme (DCPS/NPS) and gratuity following regularization
Medical reimbursement coverage under Maharashtra State Government rules post-absorption
Field Traveling Allowance (TA) for rural farm and village-level agricultural extension work
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and standard state service leave allowances upon regularisation
